analysis.reason: 직전 매수 진입 이후 3거래일 연속 관망 유지했으나, 금일 RSI 38.5 → 51.3으로 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램 또한 -5167.3316에서 128.5642로 개선되며 상승 추세 전환 신호 강화. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 1.36으로 거래량 동반 상승 확인. 240,000원 스윙 지지선 상회하며 매수 진입 근거 강화.
analysis.reasonEn: After the previous buy entry, we maintained a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. However, today's RSI moved from 38.5 to 51.3, confirming an exit from the oversold territory. The MACD histogram also improved from -5167.3316 to 128.5642, strengthening the signal for an upward trend reversal. The volume ratio of 1.36 compared to the 5-day average confirms increased trading volume accompanying the move. The price is trading above the 240,000 won swing support level, reinforcing the basis for a buy entry.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 242,000) vs SMA5 (KRW 221,400)/SMA20 (KRW 239,775)/SMA50 (KRW 253,800): Diagnosing a trend reversal phase with price above short-term SMA5 and SMA20, but below mid-term SMA50.
· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 271,314)/SMA200 (KRW 236,129): Continuing a long-term downtrend, attempting a rebound above SMA200.
· 52-week position (52.7%) + Current price level is high relative to historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (38.5→51.3) + Confirmed exit from oversold territory + Strengthening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-5167.3316→128.5642) + Improvement diagnosed + Trend reversal signal confirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band KRW 239,775) + Bandwidth of 41.53% suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (KRW 240,000) + Support confirmed based on pivot point (KRW 241,667).
· Swing resistance level (KRW 267,000) + Potential for further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low formed, now consolidating) + Diagnosing a recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.36x) + Increased confidence in the price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Buy entry condition met with confirmation of support at KRW 240,000.
